items.name: Oracle Red
items.role: the wordmark, and only the wordmark. It appears in the masthead at the top of every page and is not used for any button, link, border, band or highlight. Elsew…

items.name: Action Charcoal
items.role: the fill behind every primary action on the site. Warm rather than neutral, and a clear step lighter than so a filled button reads as an object rather than as…

items.name: Action Charcoal Pressed
items.role: the active state of that button.

items.name: On Primary
items.role: the label on a filled action, and the text colour on every inverted surface.

items.name: Gold Rule
items.role: a 40 × 4px bar sitting under the hero headline on every product page. The system's one piece of ornament.

items.name: Gold Tab
items.role: a paler gold, 5px tall, marking the selected item in the dark product sub-navigation.

items.name: Canvas
items.role: the masthead, the footer, content cards, and the brightest section bands.

items.name: Canvas Soft
items.role: the most common product-page section fill. One barely-perceptible step off white.

items.name: Canvas Tint
items.role: the next step, used for supporting sections and the contact hero.

items.name: Canvas Warm
items.role: the warmest and most-used tint, carrying the corporate index page almost end to end and every product hero band.

items.name: Hairline
items.role: the tile and disabled-control border, and the last neutral rung before the dark end.

items.name: Divider
items.role: the 2px vertical rule that separates the contact page's channel columns.

items.name: Field Border
items.role: the 1px border around the masthead search field, one clear step darker than so an input reads as interactive against a card that merely reads as a container.

items.name: Ink Deep
items.role: the dark end of the ladder, used as a full-width band behind the product sub-navigation.

items.name: Ink
items.role: every heading and every line of body copy. A warm near-black, never pure black, which keeps the very light 300-weight display sizes from looking harsh.

items.name: Link
items.role: inline links in body copy and channel columns. A deep teal-blue, set without an underline, at the same size and weight as the text around it — the colour alone…

items.name: Focus
items.role: the focus indicator, declared once and applied identically on light and dark surfaces, so a keyboard user sees the same ring everywhere.

items.name: Error
items.role: validation messaging and error field text.

items.name: Disabled Ink
items.role: the label on a disabled control, paired with a fill and a border.

items.name: Band Teal
items.role: a pale teal strip, roughly 120 to 160px tall, used to break a run of neutral sections.

items.name: Band Forest
items.role: a deep green band carrying white text and a multi-column link list, around 390px tall.

strengths.title: 빨강은 로고에만 쓴다
strengths.why: #c74634는 워드마크에만 나온다. 모든 행동은 짙은 회갈색 #312d2a 4px 버튼이 맡는다.

strengths.title: 따뜻한 회색 단계로 구역을 나눈다
strengths.why: #ffffff, #fbf9f8, #f5f4f2, #f1efed, #e4e1dd, #211e1c 여섯 단계 바탕을 바꿔 구역을 나눈다. 카드나 선을 쓰지 않는다.

strengths.title: 장식은 금색 막대 하나뿐이다
strengths.why: 히어로 제목 아래 40×4px #f0cc71 막대 하나가 페이지의 유일한 장식이다.

strengths.title: 템플릿마다 제목 글꼴이 다르다
strengths.why: 회사 첫 화면은 Oracle Sans 300, 제품 페이지는 Georgia로 제목을 쓰고 서로 섞지 않는다.

strengths.title: 그림자를 쓰지 않는다
strengths.why: 높낮이는 회색 단계의 위치로만 보여 준다. 전체 폭 띠와 푸터는 0px 모서리다.

learn: 색을 거의 안 쓰는 화면이라면 오라클처럼 따뜻한 회색 몇 단계를 정해 구역마다 바탕만 바꿔 나눈다.
장식을 넣을 때 오라클처럼 "한 페이지에 금색 막대 하나"처럼 개수를 정해 두면 그 하나가 눈에 띈다.
